name: Git Worktree
description: Safe worktree branch-swap tool for sandboxed agents. Switches assigned worktree to target branch with strict validation.

assignments.description: Per-agent worktree and bare repo path assignments.

worktreePath.description: Absolute POSIX path to the agent's assigned worktree.

bareRepoPath.description: Absolute POSIX path to the bare repository.

allowedBaseRefs.description: Allowed base refs for branch creation (e.g. origin/main).

assignments.label: Agent Assignments
assignments.help: Map agent IDs to worktreePath and bareRepoPath. Each agent gets one assigned worktree.

allowedBaseRefs.label: Allowed Base Refs
allowedBaseRefs.help: List of refs allowed as base when creating new branches (default: origin/main).
